prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with a recent collision in which a vehicle sideswiped our client while changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any other party attempts to make contact with our client about the claim, please let us know promptly.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any other policies that may provide coverage for this loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that such materials are not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
